notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
-Fixed sound effect volume buttons in the title screen audio settings. They were checking the music audio level before decreasing or increasing sound volume.
-Hid the mute music and mute sounds button in the pause screen to not mess with the desktop audio settings.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch notes
notes.content:
[b]Achievement changes:[/b]
-Daredevil achievement should now unlock from reaching the normal ending in both regular gameplay and Time Trial mode if player did not pick up any life fruits.
-The End...? Achievement should now unlock from seeing the true ending if the player completely skipped seeing the normal ending.

[b]Map adjustments:[/b]
-Fixed some secret room icons on map not blinking and not displaying Timmy icon while inside them.
-Map will now display subtle hints where the remaining secret levels are after loading a save after reaching the normal ending.

notes.title: Extended demo now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=H7W5RxdUEcw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey friends!

I decided to make an extended version of the demo! I figured the current one was too short and didn't showcase enough what the game has to offer, so I now have increased the demo length: It's now possible to receive the second item upgrade throwing knives, and the demo now ends to the second boss, the might fish Steelmaw!

Download the free extended demo, and don't forget to wishlist the full game, coming 7th of March!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179810/Tiny_Dangerous_Dungeons_Remake/
